title: Role
description: One role module (EE-229): a role an agent or a person holds, at packages/naive/src/roles/<id>/role.json in the role library beside the role's SKILL.md, overlaid by a venture's own roles at <venture>/governance/roles/<id>/role.json. A person role (kind person) is never deployed as an agent. The founder is the chief delegator and holds all authority; every other role holds only what is granted to it in governance/delegation.json, and only from the classes it lists as grantable. An agent's work is verified by another role (verified_by), never by itself; only the chief delegator has no verifier. Checked by packages/naive/src/checks/check-roles.ts and packages/naive/src/checks/check-delegation.ts.

aliases.description: Other names for this role (such as cto for architect); the id is canonical. No alias is another role's id or alias

kind.description: Who holds the role: a person, an agent or either. A person role is never deployed as an agent, and its default_tier, when it has one, is person

status.description: Optional: durable for a library role (the default); temporary for a role a lead wrote for one venture, which only a person makes durable by accepting the promote-role-<id> decision (naive workers promote, EE-235)

merged_from.description: Optional: the roles this one merges, by id; its pcf and artifacts are the union of theirs and its reach the union of their reaches, never wider than the lead that writes it (naive workers role --merge, EE-235)

proposed_by.description: Optional: who wrote a temporary role (naive workers role, EE-235): a lead, or a person

created_at.description: Optional: when a temporary role was written, an ISO date-time (naive workers role, EE-235)

chief_delegator.description: True for the founder only: the root of every delegation chain

function.description: The function the role serves: an id in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json (such as products, marketing-and-sales or human-capital), or all for the chief delegator and for a lead (a role with a portfolio). packages/naive/src/checks/check-delegation.ts fails on any other value

portfolio.description: A lead only (lead agents design, 2026-11-08): the functions, ids in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json, whose cross-function work this lead plans and verifies. A role with a portfolio is a lead: its function is all, it may be granted no never-redelegated class and no one-way door, and the leads' portfolios cover every function exactly once (packages/naive/src/checks/check-delegation.ts)

default_measure_kinds.description: A lead only: the telos measure kinds it is bound to by default (primary means the telos's primary measure). A venture binds the lead to concrete measure ids in its lead plan (operations/lead/[id]); the defaults only route a task whose measure no lead plan binds (packages/naive/src/engine/route-task.ts)

grantable_classes.description: Decision classes (from decision-rights.json) this role may be granted; the chief delegator lists none, since it holds all

default_tier.description: Who runs the role by default: person (a human, who holds accountability), frontier (the strongest available model, for high-leverage, novel, low-volume work), workhorse (a strong, cheaper model for high-volume, well-specified work) or none (deterministic scripts and CI)

lint_suites.description: Lint routes it runs, such as marketing/brand-lint

verified_by.description: The role that verifies its work; null only for the chief delegator

also_verified_by.description: Further verifiers for some work, such as the founder for spend

skill.description: Path from the repository root to the skill the role's work draws on; the role's own SKILL.md beside role.json says how to act as the role

person_kind.description: A person role only: what kind of part the person plays in the venture (EE-082)

founder.description: A person role only: whether the holder is a founder of the venture, with a file in people/founders/ and a place in the founder agreement

owns_when_solo.description: A person role only: whether a person alone in this role owns every function the venture imports

onet.description: Optional: the O*NET occupations the role matches (filled from EE-232)

basis.description: On what basis the occupation was matched

pcf.description: Optional: the APQC PCF elements the role answers for, each with its RACI part (filled from EE-232)

reads.description: Optional: the record types the role reads. What it depends on is derived from these against other roles' artifacts, never typed

artifacts.description: Optional: what the role produces, each a record type in the data model or a document kind in packages/naive/src/functions/documents.json (filled from EE-230)

standards.description: Optional: the standards the role works to, as reference ids

research.description: Optional: how the role researches (filled from EE-233)

methods.description: The research methods in the order the role reaches for them

questions.description: The questions the role asks first

level.description: Optional: the role's default responsibility level on SFIA's scale of 1 to 7
